segments.name: Hardware
segments.description: Builds and sells LRAD acoustic hailing devices and mass notification speakers to governments, militaries and law enforcement for warning and de-escalation.
segments.evidence: LRAD products provide audible voice messages with exceptional vocal clarity from close range out to 5,000 meters.

segments.name: Software
products: Genasys Protect alerting and evacuation management software services
AI-powered traffic management solutions by Ladris
segments.description: Provides the Genasys Protect software platform for emergency warning, mass notification and critical event management to governments and enterprises.
segments.evidence: Genasys Protect is a comprehensive portfolio of Protective Communications software and hardware systems serving federal governments and agencies; SLED; and enterprise organizations in sectors including, but not limited to, oil and gas, utilities, manufacturing, automotive, and healthcare.

revenueModel.text: Governments, militaries, large end-users, system integrators and resellers pay for LRAD hardware and Genasys Protect software through direct sales and a distribution channel.
revenueModel.evidence: In executing our strategy, we use direct sales to governments, militaries, large end-users, system integrators, and prime vendors.
